gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-space-grotesk: Hollow-reed counters give the body a crisp, geometric read, set beneath the loose handwriting of LXGW WenKai TC. Space Grotesk is the sans that keeps that hand honest, a sturdy partner for brief, friendly lines.
gen-gf-mali-fs-amulya: Generous gaps in every curve keep the body text open and contemporary under the inviting, hand-lettered Mali headings. Amulya brings the modern edge and Mali the casual warmth, a mix that stays friendly for a short spell.
gen-gf-mali-fs-recia: Casual charm meets sharp authority. Mali handwrites the heading with inviting, casual curves, then Recia takes over with a serif body whose faint modulation rewards close looking across a few lines.
gen-gf-mali-fs-rowan: Rowan opens every curve generously and draws thin strokes at about half the weight of thick ones. Rowan keeps a literary, friendly voice beneath Mali's casual hand, better for a brief note than a lengthy chapter.
gen-gf-mali-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans leaves wide gaps between curve ends and stems, with vertical and horizontal strokes of identical weight. Spline Sans moves along amiably under Mali's casual lettering, made for quick reading rather than a marathon.
gen-gf-mali-sora: Mali's handwriting is casual, with c tips that never touch. Sora supplies a precise, geometric sans-serif whose curves turn corners without any pressure swell, a tidy foil that is pleasant in light helpings.
gen-gf-margarine-fs-paquito: Paquito brings a confident, approachable serif voice, its lowercase hugging the capitals closely. Paquito lets the big, plotter-smooth lowercase of Margarine do the shouting, then settles into quick, light reading.
gen-gf-medievalsharp-fs-karma: MedievalSharp stands out for its wide-mouthed letters. Karma adds a trustworthy, classic serif whose terminals stop short of the stem, and next to MedievalSharp it feels settled and steady.
gen-gf-medievalsharp-fs-paquito: Close-set lowercase and capitals give the body a confident, approachable read beneath the bold display letters of MedievalSharp. Paquito does its best work in quick bursts of text, with extended reading asking more of the eye.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-bhutuka-expanded-: BhuTuka Expanded One is a literary, authoritative serif whose thin joins are no thinner than its stems. And over extended reading, its curvy, unclamped letters slow the pace to a leisurely walk beneath Metamorphous.
